strings.en: There is only ever one justice. And it is on our side!
Earth, which oppressed us and drove us to Jupiter, deserves destruction!
We will surely crush the evil Earth!
We fight for justice! Justice will prevail!
I desire no conflict. Needless killing is truly meaningless. ...However!
The evil empire shall be destroyed by justice!
Justice is on our side!
Ngh!! All hands, evacuate!
Our justice...!
Don't lose heart! There is only one justice!
Not yet! Hold on somehow!
Show them your last ounce of pride!
We will not yield! Let's go!
What's wrong?! Can't you dodge!!
Ngh! We're still fine! Justice wins!!
Don't rely on the spacetime distortion field!
Ngh... Prepare to intercept!
Is that all!? Evil empire!
Don't let them near! Lay down a barrage!!
It's nothing serious!
We won't lose to the evil Earth!
Is that all!? Evil empire!
Emergency evasion!!
Not good enough! Evil Earth!
An attack like this does no damage!
The spacetime distortion field is working!
Out of energy!? Resupply at once!!
Attacking from outside our range!? Cowards!
Justice will prevail!
Fools! You underestimated our power!!
We can't let it fall now!
If that's all, this ship will take the hit!
